subject: Dedicated pool contention + reserved throughput gap — urgent exec bridge
messages:
From: ops@finbank.com
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-12 09:12 PDT
Subject: Spike in timeouts / token queueing impacting FinBank production

Rafael —

We started seeing elevated 5xxs and queuing for our reserved capacity starting ~08:45 PT. Impact: user-facing latency spiking from 120ms to 2.5s on inference paths that touch longer sequences. Retries are increasing (observed ~12% higher) and a handful of important payment flows experienced transient failures.

Attached: finbank_error_traces.log and a short export of request timing. This coincides with a sudden increase in non-Prod billing/ETL jobs that hit the same pool (we believe a partner batch landed unexpectedly).

Can you confirm whether fallback routing or priority customer isolation can be triggered now? Need ETA and plan — this is impacting a scheduled end-of-day payroll job.

— Marcus (FinBank Ops)
From: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: ops@finbank.com
Date: 2027-04-12 09:34 PDT
Subject: Re: Spike in timeouts / token queueing impacting FinBank production

Team — escalating. Summary: FinBank reserved pool showing severe queueing/latency starting 08:45 PT. Early signals indicate an unanticipated request surge (partner ETL) landed on the reserved pool due to a routing policy overlap; reserved throughput consumed by non-priority jobs. Attached snapshot of pool metrics (pool_metrics_20270412.csv).

Immediate asks/mitigation proposals (short window):
- (Irene) Flip FinBank to emergency fallback routing to their hosted model variant (redirect to hosted cluster S-compact) to buy 15–30m headroom.
- (Marissa) Notify FinBank PM + Ops with an acknowledgement and ETA for mitigation; propose 1) temporary credits for affected runs and 2) targeted throttling guard for partner jobs.
- (Vivek) Approve a one-time dedicated burst (reserve extra GPUs) for 2 hours while we investigate root cause and apply routing guard. We will document cost and request exec sign-off on credits.
- (Priyom) Lead post-incident review and changes to reserved routing rules so partner batches cannot target customer reserved pools.

I will coordinate the bridge and keep Marcus (ops@finbank.com) on copies. Please confirm who will own each item in the next 10 minutes — Marcus reports payroll run still running and risk of failure if we do not act quickly.

Thanks,
Rafael
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, ops@finbank.com
Date: 2027-04-12 09:51 PDT
Subject: Re: Re: Spike in timeouts / token queueing impacting FinBank production

Rafael — thanks for the quick summary. Approve the following now:

1) One-time burst: engineering is authorized to provision +2 reserved GPU nodes to FinBank pool for up to 3 hours. Cost will be charged to incident budget and reconciled with Finance — Marissa coordinate credits.
2) Irene: trigger the fallback to hosted S-compact variant for the most latency-sensitive routes (token limit and deterministic quantized path). Ensure no data is written to customer logs without consent; keep request metadata consistent.
3) Throttle partner job: reach out to PartnerCloud and ask to pause the batch targeting FinBank pool; if they do not respond in 10m, apply automated rate-limiter rules to drop best-effort jobs.

Priyom — please prepare a short postmortem template and include immediate remediation items (routing policy whitelist, partner scheduling constraints, and alerting improvements). I want a 48-hour remediation plan and a 2-week follow-up.

Rafael/Marissa — you have exec permission to offer FinBank a goodwill credit equal to one day of reserved throughput (estimate in USD). Confirm before external comms.

Vivek
CTO
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: ops@finbank.com
Cc: rafael_mendes@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-12 13:48 PDT
Subject: Re: Spike in timeouts / token queueing impacting FinBank production — action & next steps

Marcus —

Thanks for the flag and apologies for the impact. Quick summary of actions we've taken:
- We routed latency-sensitive endpoints to our hosted S-compact variant to restore user-facing latency (live now).
- We've provisioned a temporary +2 GPU burst to your reserved pool (visible in the console) to reduce queueing while we validate routing changes.
- We applied an emergency throttle to partner jobs hitting your pool to stop the surge.

Immediate next steps:
- We will run a short verification with your team now to confirm payroll flow is healthy (can you confirm the job completed or is still in progress?).
- We will follow up with a postmortem in 48 hours and push routing-policy hardening within 2 weeks.
- Offer: Vivek approved a goodwill credit equivalent to one day of reserved throughput; I'll confirm the exact dollar amount after internal reconciliation.

Attachments: recommended-mitigations-one-pager.pdf (high-level mitigation and timeline).

I'll be on a quick bridge if you want to join: Zoom link in HubSpot thread.

— Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success (Redwood Inference)
